items.text: Mr. APPLe's flesh grows paler amidst the loud singing and wobbling fruit baskets.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: This APPLe's flesh is separating from the core ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Help me ... Captain!
The procession gathers into a surging torrent flowing through the streets.
Colorful banners and ivy-woven cushions are tossed into the sky. The avenue is now packed with floats and partiers wearing masks.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Kassandra, Vertin ... We've got to do something!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I can't let them turn Mr. APPLe into an offering! Think about how upset my listeners would be!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oi! Lads, make way, please—
Regulus charges headlong into the crowd making a beeline for her first mate.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hang in there. I'm coming for you!
There is a surge of courage and conviction burning in her veins; she'll stop at nothing to protect her crew.

items.speaker: Parading Follower I
items.text: Hey, you stepped on my robe. Be careful!

items.speaker: Parading Follower II
items.text: Put your hands up, everyone. Just like this! Haha, praise Dionysos!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Regulus, be careful. Hold my hand, stick close to me—
The surge of the crowd separates their hands. As the torrent of movement passes, only one remains.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: R-R-Regulus?
Regulus is nowhere to be seen. In place of her friend's hand there rests a green apple; its aroma tinged with a faint bitterness.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Regulus the Reckless—she's a bold one.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: But she has yet to master the art of navigating a crowd.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Huh?
Kassandra leans over from the rooftop, offering a hand up to Vertin.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Why don't you take a look from up here, Vertin?

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: As far as I'm concerned, this will be the fastest way to catch up.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: There's something about you ... it reminds me of her.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Talk later—just grab my hand.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: I remember how nervous I was the first time I climbed up along a vine.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Are you certain this is a shortcut?

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Completely.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: First, you need to calculate the distance between the two roofs. Make sure you have a proper running start and sufficient height.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Keep your body tight, eyes on your target; focusing on where you land.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Like this—

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Let your knees bend slightly as you land, then try to regain your balance.
Kassandra lands effortlessly on the opposite roof.
Her eyes scramble across the roof, her legs uneasy as she steps forward.
The distance between the rooftops seems to expand before her eyes.
But she takes a deep breath and steadies herself.
She runs through every step in her mind before she takes them and then—

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Watch out!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ugh!
She falls. Arms flailing as they miss their mark, only to be caught just in time by the muscled grip of a misthios.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you, Kassandra.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Your instincts are impeccable, but you may need a bit more training.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: This may not be the shortcut I imagined for us; let's go another way.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Is it ... more dangerous?

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: No, much safer.
Kassandra's gaze fixes on the protruding bricks before settling on a distant temple.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Relax, Vertin.
A firm hand catches her.
Followed by a gust of wind rushing against her face.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I must say, I'm in awe of your skills, Miss Kassandra.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But how do we get down from here?
She circles the edges of the roof, searching for any bricks or beams she might climb.
Unfortunately, the craftsmen have built the temple with meticulous care—the walls are so polished and pristine that not even a speck of dust clings to them.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Just hold on.
A gentle breeze brushes against her face.
They jump off the rooftop, feeling the world blur as it rushes up to meet them.
Then, the haystack below swallows them whole.
She emerges from the stack, and after regaining her composure, follows Kassandra as she slinks into the temple.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I never quite expected this mode of travel to be so ... thrilling.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: I suppose it must be; it's so natural to me now that it feels routine.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What?!
Regulus finally arrives at the scene, still gasping for breath.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: That's a trick and a half! How did you get here before I did?
Kassandra rushes over and covers Regulus's mouth.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Shhh ... We have a situation.
